plainLanguage: Section 94 inalenga public-service officer mwenye judicial/administrative duties kuhusu property, manufacture, trade au business ya special character ambaye ana private interest humo na bado anatekeleza duties hizo.
meaning: Liability under section 94 depends on the exact public-service role, conduct, knowledge or interest requirements stated by the provision.
keyPoints: Person must be employed in public service.
The employment must charge the person with the specified judicial or administrative duties.
A direct or indirect private interest in the relevant property/business is required.
The section states one year's imprisonment.

history.summary: Section 94 is in Chapter X, Abuse of Office, Penal Code [CAP. 16 R.E. 2022].
notes: Official text checked against the government R.E. 2022 source.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: Public-office offences should be analysed from the exact statutory duties, interests and mental elements.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: Official status alone is not enough; evidence must establish the specific conduct required by the section.

debateQuestion: Je, evidence inathibitisha kila statutory element ya section 94?
disclaimer: Ufafanuzi huu si maandishi rasmi ya sheria.
